newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombian peso ends lower vs dollar at 1,022.20.
newsitem.headline: Colombian peso ends lower vs dollar at 1,022.20.

text.p: Colombia's peso closed 1.95 lower against the dollar at 1,022.20 in active trading on the country's interbank market, dealers said.
They said the peso's slide was prompted a surge in demand for dollars late in the trading session. The peso had gained in early trade on dollar sales by oil exporters.
The peso hit an intraday low of 1,024.30 and a high of 1,018.50 before settling at 1,022.20 at the close. Dealers reported an above-average 357 trades for $155 million.
